title: Dark Brotherhood
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Dark Brotherhood: the Falkreath Sanctuary family, the assassins sent after the player, and the contract victims, vanilla, DLC and CC.

families.holds: the Falkreath Sanctuary family (Astrid, Arnbjorn, Babette, Cicero, Festus Krex, Gabriella, Nazir, Veezara, Lis), their quest and dead copies, and the Dawnstar initiates
the assassins of `WEJS28` (`WEAssassinSubChar`, PC×1.1 [6–45]), the Hag's End assassin, the CC assassins (Bow of Shadows, Daedric armor pack) and the Dawnstar Sanctuary Guardians
the contract victims: the main questline (`DB01`–`DB11`), Nazir's side contracts (`DBSideContract01`–`12`, Agnis and Maluril included) and the ten recurring targets (`DBrecurring`)

filedElsewhere.what: the targets Gaius Maro (`DB06`) and Commander Maro (`DB11`, optional)
